// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=ClosedXml&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Plugins/ClosedXmlTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=ClosedXml&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using ClosedXML.Excel;

// Verify.ClosedXml: Converts an Excel workbook into a metadata snapshot, a csv per sheet, and a deterministic xlsx.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.ClosedXml
// Note: One verification writes three files or more: the metadata as text, the deterministic xlsx,
// and a csv per sheet.
// Note: Values that Verify scrubs, such as guids and dates, are scrubbed inside the csv cells too.
// Note: VerifyClosedXml.Initialize() only registers converters, so it is safe to call after a
// verification has already run.
public class ClosedXmlTests
{
    // The csv per sheet is what makes the diff readable: a changed cell is one changed line,
    // rather than a different binary file. Formulas are appended to the cell they belong to.
    [Fact]
    public Task Workbook()
    {
        using var book = new XLWorkbook();

        var sheet = book.Worksheets.Add("Basic Data");

        sheet.Cell("A1").Value = "Id";
        sheet.Cell("B1").Value = "Name";

        sheet.Cell("A2").Value = 1;
        sheet.Cell("B2").Value = "John Doe";

        return Verify(book);
    }

    // The same conversion for a workbook that already exists, whether it is a fixture or
    // something the code under test wrote.
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.xlsx in the test project, copied to the output directory.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.xlsx in the test project, copied to the output directory.")]
    public Task WorkbookFile()
    {
        return VerifyFile("sample.xlsx");
    }

    // Deflate compression differs between runtimes, so the xlsx bytes differ even when the
    // content does not. A snapshot per runtime keeps that from failing a test.
    [Fact]
    public Task UniqueForRuntime()
    {
        using var book = new XLWorkbook();
        book.Worksheets.Add("Basic Data");
        return Verify(book)
            .UniqueForRuntime();
    }
}
